THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE BUILD

Meet the team.

Different interests. One shared project. Meet the people bringing our Corvair back to life.

Meet the team ↓
LEGACY GARAGE 26 / RESEDA, CA

Old enough to be classic.
Young enough to turn heads.

01

Sam Y

Founder

Hi, my name is Sam Yang. I am a high school student and the founder of the 1968 Chevrolet Corvair rebuilding project, which combines hands-on automotive work with problem-solving, creativity, and content creation. Through my interests in sports, technology, and engineering, I hope to inspire younger people to explore innovation, classic cars, and community-building.

samyang@legacygarage26.org↗
02

Mark

My name is Mark. I have years of experience building, restoring, and maintaining Corvairs, as well as other American classic cars and trucks. I love my job and working on Corvairs!

03

Doris W

Hi, I’m Doris Wu. I enjoy drawing and nature. I have a great interest in cars, and I hope to use my art skills to create illustrations and designs for the project. I also have some experience in editing. During the project, I hope to learn more about Corvairs, and I would love the opportunity to learn about vehicle modification.

dorisw@legacygarage26.org↗
04

Fay

Hi, my name is Fay, and I am part of the Legacy Garage team. Ever since I attended an engineering course at my school, I’ve started liking engineering and 3D printing. I have more experience in drawing and sketching. I hope to contribute my art skills and gain more experience in building.

faycao@legacygarage26.org↗
05

Mona

Hi, I’m Mona, a college student passionate about creativity, business, technology, and connecting with others. I enjoy singing, dancing, traveling, and exploring new cultures. Through leadership and creative projects, I’ve built strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. I hope to combine creativity, business, and technology to create meaningful projects and inspire others.

monaliao@legacygarage26.org↗
